narrative.details:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment.

Its clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
narrative.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
narrative.offerRewardText: The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.
narrative.requestItemsText: The mark of a leader is the ability to admit when they were wrong. I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 10 to 12, 3,765 XP in all.

quests.name: The Missing Scholar
quests.objectiveText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.

quests.name: Fillion's Mission
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

quests.name: Catching Wind
quests.objectiveText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it once there.

quests.name: Avenged Tenfold
quests.objectiveText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

quests.name: In Service of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
